text:
lena-cs: Morning team — quick pre-cutover checklist for HarborView private deployment. Need green on network CIDR, egress rules to our model registry, IAM assume-role for their infra, KMS alias + grants, and CloudTrail delivery to their audit bucket. Window is 15:30-17:30 PT.

omar-sre: On it. HarborView sent 10.50.0.0/16 as their VPC. We're proposing to place the inference nodes in 10.50.2.0/24 and the proxy in 10.50.3.0/24. Any overlapping peering routes on their side?

keith-customer: Confirmed from infra: no overlap with existing on-prem ranges (they're 172.31.0.0/16). We will still add specific route exclusions to be safe.

rialto-eng: For IAM, we'll create role rb-harborview-infer-role with trust to acct 776655443322. Policy will be scoped to: AssumeRole, logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents to their audit stream, and s3:GetObject for models. Will post policy snippet in a sec.

lena-cs: Please make sure session duration limited to 1 hour and MFA not required for service account. Also customer requested an explicit deny for s3:DeleteObject on the audit bucket.

rialto-eng: noted. Policy snippet: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::776655443322:root"}}]}
```

audit-bot: CloudTrail configured to deliver to s3://harborview-audit-logs-prod. Bucket encryption set to SSE-KMS, KMS key: alias/harborview-prod-key. Delivery test logged at 2024-02-12T21:04:12Z.

omar-sre: I verified the bucket ACLs and blocked public access. Suggest lifecycle 400d. Also added a bucket policy allowing CloudTrail service principal and our SRE role to read.

keith-customer: SOC wants the raw CloudTrail events forwarded to their SIEM. They'll accept a Firehose endpoint in their account. Need cross-account grant on the KMS key for decrypt by Firehose.

lena-cs: Who will own the KMS grants? We need explicit grant for redwood service principal + their Firehose role.

rialto-eng: I can add the grants. Two questions: do they want automated monthly rotation or manual rotation?

keith-customer: Preference is automated monthly rotation with an ops approval ticket.

omar-sre: We'll implement rotation via Lambda with a PR that requires two approvers. I'll stub that in infra repo and link the PR here.

lena-cs: Good. Remaining operational tasks: 1) IAM cross-account assume smoke test (rialto + omar) 2) KMS grant & rotation PR (rialto) 3) Canary inference + perf baseline (omar) 4) SIEM forwarding test (keith + rilato).

omar-sre: For canary: I'll run 3 phases (t0, t+10m, t+30m) with 50 concurrent requests each and capture p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec, GPU util. Will stream metrics to #release-war-room.

rialto-eng: I'll drop the IAM assume command for testing: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/rb-harborview-infer-role --role-session-name cutover-smoke` — I'll run from their test account and post results.

audit-bot: Runbook item 4 (CloudTrail delivery validation) marked PASSED at 1798881275 by audit-bot.

lena-cs: Nice. Scheduling note: start traffic flip at 15:45 PT to allow one follow-up window. Keep ops on call for 90 minutes. If anything abnormal, rollback to hosted fallback `redwood-hosted-gen-1`.

keith-customer: HarborView will have their network engineer on the call and their SOC on standby. We'll escalate immediately if SIEM ingest fails.

omar-sre: One blocker possibility: outbound NAT to model registry (models.redwood-internal.s3) must allow 443 to our model CIDR. I've opened a firewall rule ticket; expect approval in 20m.

lena-cs: If firewall approval misses the window, we'll use a short-lived pre-signed URL for model pull as contingency. Please prep that flow.

rialto-eng: prepping pre-signed workflow now. Also adding console note for the expected KMS alias name so customer UI shows alias/harborview-prod-key.

lena-cs: Thanks. After the 90m monitor, I'll collect feedback and file any follow-up action items in the onboarding retro doc: https://redwood.internal/templates/priv-onboard-retro (internal).

audit-bot: Post-cutover checklist reminder scheduled at 1798881600.

lena-cs: Perfect. Tag me if you hit any blocker. I'll keep the customer looped.
